{"result": "1	"""Convert a BlastNet trajectory directory to WELL HDF5 format (v4).
2	
3	Supports 2D and 3D datasets. Grid, time, and BC handling adapt automatically
4	based on the dataset name and info.json contents.
5	
6	Changes from v3:
7	- Data file paths are constructed directly as data/{varname}_id{id:04d}.dat
8	  instead of reading from info.json filename fields, which can be mislabeled
9	  (e.g. UX/UY are swapped in nonreacting_channel_flow).
10	"""
11	
12	import json
13	import argparse
14	from pathlib import Path
15	
16	import numpy as np
17	import h5py
18	
19	# BlastNet variable name → WELL field name
20	SCALAR_MAP = {
21	    "RHO_kgm-3": "density",
22	    "P_Pa":       "pressure",
23	    "T_K":        "temperature",
24	    "YH":         "mass_fraction_h",
25	    "YH2":        "mass_fraction_h2",
26	    "YO":         "mass_fraction_o",
27	    "YO2":        "mass_fraction_o2",
28	    "YOH":        "mass_fraction_oh",
29	    "YH2O":       "mass_fraction_h2o",
30	    "YHO2":       "mass_fraction_ho2",
31	    "YH2O2":      "mass_fraction_h2o2",
32	}
33	
34	VELOCITY_VARS = ["UX_ms-1", "UY_ms-1", "UZ_ms-1"]
35	
36	# BC config per dataset: list of (dim_name, group_name, bc_type, mask_style)
37	#   mask_style "all"      → True for every grid point (periodic)
38	#   mask_style "endpoint" → True only at first and last index (wall / open)
39	BC_CONFIGS = {
40	    "lifted_hydrogen_jet": [
41	        ("x", "x_open",     "OPEN",     "endpoint"),
42	        ("y", "y_open",     "OPEN",     "endpoint"),
43	    ],
44	    "nonreacting_channel_flow": [
45	        ("x", "x_periodic", "PERIODIC", "all"),
46	        ("y", "y_wall",     "WALL",     "endpoint"),
47	        ("z", "z_periodic", "PERIODIC", "all"),
48	    ],
49	}
50	
51	_STR_DT = h5py.string_dtype()
52	
53	
54	def _str_attr(grp_or_file, name, lst):
55	    if not lst:
56	        grp_or_file.attrs[name] = np.array([], dtype=np.float64)
57	    else:
58	        grp_or_file.attrs.create(name, data=np.array(lst, dtype=object), dtype=_STR_DT)
59	
60	
61	def load_dat(path):
62	    try:
63	        return np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.float32)
64	    except Exception:
65	        return np.fromfile(path, dtype=np.float64).astype(np.float32)
66	
67	
68	def load_grid_1d(traj_dir, grid_path_str, expected_size, ny_nx_shape=None):
69	    """Load a grid file and return a 1D coordinate array.
70	
71	    If the file contains exactly expected_size elements it is already 1D.
72	    Otherwise assumes a 2D (Ny, Nx) Fortran-style layout and extracts coords:
73	      - first call (x): first row of (Ny, Nx) array
74	      - second call (y): first column of (Ny, Nx) array
75	    ny_nx_shape is required for the 2D case.
76	    """
77	    flat = load_dat(traj_dir / grid_path_str.lstrip("./"))
78	    if flat.size == expected_size:
79	        return flat.astype(np.float32)
80	    # 2D grid layout
81	    Ny, Nx = ny_nx_shape
82	    arr2d = flat.reshape(Ny, Nx)
83	    if expected_size == Nx:
84	        return arr2d[0, :].astype(np.float32)   # row 0 → x-coordinates
85	    else:
86	        return arr2d[:, 0].astype(np.float32)   # col 0 → y-coordinates
87	
88	
89	def convert(traj_dir: Path, output_file: Path, dry_run: bool = False):
90	    traj_dir     = Path(traj_dir)
91	    dataset_name = traj_dir.parent.name
92	
93	    with open(traj_dir / "info.json") as f:
94	        info = json.load(f)
95	
96	    g         = info["global"]
97	    Nxyz      = g["Nxyz"]                   # [Nx, Ny] or [Nx, Ny, Nz]
98	    n_dims    = len(Nxyz)
99	    n_steps   = g["snapshots"]
100	    variables = g["variables"]
101	    dim_names = ["x", "y", "z"][:n_dims]
102	
103	    # Time array
104	    local_by_id = {entry["id"]: entry for entry in info["local"]}
105	    sorted_ids  = sorted(local_by_id)
106	    if "time-step snapshot [s]" in g:
107	        dt    = g["time-step snapshot [s]"]
108	        times = (np.arange(n_steps) * dt).astype(np.float32)
109	    else:
110	        times = np.array([local_by_id[sid]["time"] for sid in sorted_ids],
111	                         dtype=np.float32)
112	
113	    # Grid coordinates (1D per dimension)
114	    ny_nx = (Nxyz[1], Nxyz[0]) if n_dims == 2 else None   # only needed for 2D layout
115	    grid_coords = {}
116	    for dname in dim_names:
117	        expected = Nxyz[dim_names.index(dname)]
118	        grid_coords[dname] = load_grid_1d(
119	            traj_dir, g["grid"][dname], expected, ny_nx)
120	
121	    # Separate scalar and velocity variables
122	    scalar_blastnet = [v for v in variables if v not in VELOCITY_VARS]
123	    vel_blastnet    = [v for v in variables if v in VELOCITY_VARS]
124	    scalar_well     = [SCALAR_MAP.get(v, v) for v in scalar_blastnet]
125	    n_vel_dims      = len(vel_blastnet)
126	
127	    print(f"Dataset       : {dataset_name}")
128	    print(f"Traj dir      : {traj_dir}")
129	    print(f"n_spatial_dims: {n_dims}  Nxyz={Nxyz}")
130	    print(f"Steps         : {n_steps}  time=[{times[0]:.4g} .. {times[-1]:.4g}]")
131	    print(f"Scalars       : {scalar_well}")
132	    print(f"Velocity      : {vel_blastnet}  ({n_vel_dims}D)")
133	    print(f"Output        : {output_file}")
134	
135	    if dry_run:
136	        print("[dry-run] No file written.")
137	        return
138	
139	    output_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
140	
141	    bc_config   = BC_CONFIGS.get(dataset_name, [])
142	    field_shape = tuple([1, n_steps] + list(Nxyz))
143	    vel_shape   = tuple([1, n_steps] + list(Nxyz) + [n_vel_dims])
144	    dim_varying = np.array([True] * n_dims)
145	
146	    if not bc_config:
147	        print(f"WARNING: no BC config for '{dataset_name}', "
148	              "boundary_conditions group will be empty.")
149	
150	    with h5py.File(output_file, "w") as f:
151	        # Root attributes
152	        f.attrs["dataset_name"]   = dataset_name
153	        f.attrs["grid_type"]      = "cartesian"
154	        f.attrs["n_spatial_dims"] = n_dims
155	        f.attrs["n_trajectories"] = 1
156	        _str_attr(f, "simulation_parameters", [])
157	
158	        # dimensions
159	        dim_grp = f.create_group("dimensions")
160	        _str_attr(dim_grp, "spatial_dims", dim_names)
161	
162	        ds_t = dim_grp.create_dataset("time", data=times)
163	        ds_t.attrs["sample_varying"] = False
164	        ds_t.attrs["time_varying"]   = True
165	
166	        for dname in dim_names:
167	            ds = dim_grp.create_dataset(dname, data=grid_coords[dname])
168	            ds.attrs["sample_varying"] = False
169	            ds.attrs["time_varying"]   = False
170	
171	        # boundary_conditions
172	        bc_grp = f.create_group("boundary_conditions")
173	        for dim_name, grp_label, bc_type, mask_style in bc_config:
174	            size = Nxyz[dim_names.index(dim_name)]
175	            mask = (np.ones(size, dtype=np.int8) if mask_style == "all"
176	                    else np.array([1] + [0] * (size - 2) + [1], dtype=np.int8))
177	            grp = bc_grp.create_group(grp_label)
178	            _str_attr(grp, "associated_dims",   [dim_name])
179	            _str_attr(grp, "associated_fields", [])
180	            grp.attrs["bc_type"]        = bc_type
181	            grp.attrs["sample_varying"] = False
182	            grp.attrs["time_varying"]   = False
183	            grp.create_dataset("mask", data=mask)
184	
185	        # scalars (empty placeholder)
186	        sc_grp = f.create_group("scalars")
187	        _str_attr(sc_grp, "field_names", [])
188	
189	        # t0_fields
190	        t0_grp = f.create_group("t0_fields")
191	        _str_attr(t0_grp, "field_names", scalar_well)
192	        t0_ds = {}
193	        for wname in scalar_well:
194	            ds = t0_grp.create_dataset(
195	                wname, shape=field_shape, dtype=np.float32,
196	                chunks=tuple([1, 1] + list(Nxyz)))
197	            ds.attrs["dim_varying"]    = dim_varying
198	            ds.attrs["sample_varying"] = True
199	            ds.attrs["time_varying"]   = True
200	            t0_ds[wname] = ds
201	
202	        # t1_fields — velocity
203	        t1_grp = f.create_group("t1_fields")
204	        _str_attr(t1_grp, "field_names", ["velocity"] if n_vel_dims > 0 else [])
205	        vel_ds = None
206	        if n_vel_dims > 0:
207	            vel_ds = t1_grp.create_dataset(
208	                "velocity", shape=vel_shape, dtype=np.float32,
209	                chunks=tuple([1, 1] + list(Nxyz) + [n_vel_dims]))
210	            vel_ds.attrs["dim_varying"]    = dim_varying
211	            vel_ds.attrs["sample_varying"] = True
212	            vel_ds.attrs["time_varying"]   = True
213	
214	        # t2_fields (empty)
215	        t2_grp = f.create_group("t2_fields")
216	        _str_attr(t2_grp, "field_names", [])
217	
218	        # Write data one timestep at a time.
219	        # Paths are constructed directly from variable name and snapshot ID to
220	        # avoid mislabeled filename entries in info.json (e.g. UX/UY swap in
221	        # nonreacting_channel_flow).
222	        for step_idx, sid in enumerate(sorted_ids):
223	            print(f"  step {step_idx+1}/{n_steps}", end="\r", flush=True)
224	
225	            def dat_path(varname):
226	                return traj_dir / "data" / f"{varname}_id{sid:04d}.dat"
227	
228	            for bname, wname in zip(scalar_blastnet, scalar_well):
229	                t0_ds[wname][0, step_idx] = load_dat(dat_path(bname)).reshape(*Nxyz)
230	
231	            if vel_ds is not None:
232	                vel_stack = np.stack(
233	                    [load_dat(dat_path(v)).reshape(*Nxyz) for v in vel_blastnet],
234	                    axis=-1)
235	                vel_ds[0, step_idx] = vel_stack
236	
237	        print(f"\nWrote {output_file}")
238	
239	
240	def main():
241	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
242	        description="Convert a BlastNet trajectory directory to WELL HDF5 format.")
243	    parser.add_argument("traj_dir",
244	                        help="Path to trajectory directory containing info.json")
245	    parser.add_argument("--output-path", default="./well_output_v2",
246	                        help="Output directory (default: ./well_output_v2)")
247	    parser.add_argument("--output-file",
248	                        help="Explicit output file path (overrides --output-path)")
249	    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
250	    args = parser.parse_args()
251	
252	    traj_dir = Path(args.traj_dir)
253	
254	    if args.output_file:
255	        output_file = Path(args.output_file)
256	    else:
257	        dataset_name = traj_dir.parent.name
258	        traj_name    = traj_dir.name
259	        output_file  = Path(args.output_path) / f"{dataset_name}_{traj_name}.hdf5"
260	
261	    convert(traj_dir, output_file, dry_run=args.dry_run)
262	
263	
264	if __name__ == "__main__":
265	    main()
266	"}
